documentation.content:
**A Milton service is failing to start or crash-looping.** One email per incident; it closes 30 minutes after the condition clears.

Signal: log-based metric `milton-startup-failures`, Cloud Run's system log lines `Default STARTUP TCP probe failed ... The instance was not started.` and `Container called exit(N).` (N not 0). A failed start writes both lines. The metric `container/completed_probe_count` was rejected: it did not record the one real failed start in the last 30 days (milton-auth, 2026-11-07 08:30Z, `Error: Connection terminated due to connection timeout`), because the container exited before the probe completed.

Check first:
1. `gcloud logging read 'resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND resource.labels.service_name="<service>" AND (logName:"varlog%2Fsystem" OR logName:"stderr")' --project=milton-510506 --freshness=30m --limit=50`: the stderr lines before the exit give the cause (database, secrets, configuration).
2. Did a release just move traffic, or did a secret version change? Roll back per server/deploy/README.md, "Release verification and rollback".

Threshold: 3 or more lines in a rolling 15 minutes for one service, so at least two failed starts. Reason: the 30-day worst was 2 lines (the single 11-07 failed start, which recovered on the next attempt 8 s later). A crash loop repeats every few seconds.

conditions.displayName: startup failures or crash exits: ≥ 3 in 15 min

conditionThreshold.filter: metric.type = "logging.googleapis.com/user/milton-startup-failures" AND resource.type = "cloud_run_revision" AND resource.labels.service_name = one_of("milton-app", "milton-mcp", "milton-auth", "milton-admit")
